name: Haystack
tagline: Haystack is an open-source Python framework by deepset for building NLP and RAG pipelines in production. Developers use it to connect retrieval systems, language models, and data sources into end-to-end search and question-answering applications. It has a large library of pre-built components for document stores, embedders, and generators.
